items.title: Resolution Amending Conflict of Interest Code
items.description: Biennial update of public official conflict of interest disclosure requirements.
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only. “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Adopting and Amended Conflict of Interest Code”.

items.title: Storm Water Management Facilities Covenant and Agreement
items.description: Storm Water Management WQMP/BMP Facilities Covenant and Agreement for Plot Plan (PW2024-0020).
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to Approve the Storm Water Management WQMP/BMP Facilities Covenant and Agreement for Plot Plan (PP2024-0020), MLC Fairway canyon Phase 4C.

items.title: Second Reading of Vector Control Ordinance (PLAN2024-0100)
items.description: Second reading regarding the adoption of Riverside County Ordinance No. 523 by reference, adding Chapter 8.56 (Riverside County Ordinance No. 523 Control of Vectors) to the Beaumont Municipal Code.
items.recommendation: Waive the second full reading and adopt by title only, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California Adding Chapter 8.56 ‘Control of Vectors” to the Beaumont Municipal Code Adopting by Reference Riverside County Ordinance No. 523, as Amended through 523.3 ‘An Ordinance of the County of Riverside Relating to the Control of Vectors and Incorporating by Reference Ordinance No 75,’ Codified as Chapter 8.36 (‘Control of Vectors’) Et Seq. of Riverside County Code of Ordinances”.

items.title: Establishment of a 2x2x2 Ad Hoc Meeting with the Cities of Banning and Calimesa
items.description: Ad Hoc Meeting to Discuss Truck Routes.
items.recommendation: Confirm appointed representatives, Mayor Pro Tem Lara and Council Member Voigt and direct staff to contact the cities of Banning and Calimesa.

items.title: Adoption of Development Impact Fee Nexus Study and Development Impact Fee Schedule
items.description: Hold two public hearings for the proposed adoption of the 2024 Development Impact Fee Nexus Study and Development Impact Fee Schedule.
items.recommendation: Staff recommends adopting at the maximum justified fees except for the Storm Drain Fee which is recommended to be adopted at 50% of the maximum justified fee. Hold a Public Hearing: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Adopting the City of Beaumont Development Impact Fee Study Update Dated September 6, 2024”. Hold a second Public Hearing: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Adopting the City of Beaumont 2024 Development Impact Fee Schedule Set Forth in the City of Beaumont Development Impact Fee Study Update Dated September 6, 2024”.

items.title: Continue a Public Hearing of Request to Appeal Notice of Finding Under Development Agreement
items.description: Tri Pointe Homes has requested an appeal of the City Manager’s Notice of Finding Under Development Agreement dated August 17, 2004.
items.recommendation: Continue the Public Hearing of Request to Appeal Notice of Finding Under Development Agreement dated August 17, 2004 to the City Council Meeting of November 5, 2024.

items.title: Business Incentive Program Update
items.description: Update on Business Incentive Program Use and Proposed New Incentives.
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to develop and implement the Job Creation and Retention Incentive Program. Provide additional direction to staff on the Business Incentive programs, as appropriate.

items.title: Amended and Restated Agreement with IDC Consulting Engineers, Inc. for the Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Project (CIP 2017-012)
items.description: Award an Amended and Restated Agreement to IDC Consulting Engineers, Inc. to complete the design for the Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Project (CIP 2017-012). Strategic Plan Target #2- Infrastructure/Projects/Traffic; Priority Level 1; Goal #4 – Develop Penn Grade Separation
items.recommendation: Award an Amended and Restated Agreement to IDC Consulting Engineers, Inc. to complete the design for the Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Project for an amount not to exceed $1,884,482.

items.title: Amended and Restated Agreement with Moffatt Nichol for the Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Project (CIP 2017-012)
items.description: Award an amended and restated professional services agreement to Moffatt Nichol to complete the environmental documentation for the Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Project (CIP 2017-012). Strategic Plan Target #2- Infrastructure/Projects/Traffic; Priority Level 1; Goal #4 – Develop Penn Grade Separation
items.recommendation: Award an Amended and Restated Professional Services Agreement to Moffatt Nichol to complete the environmental documentation for the Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Project for an amount not to exceed $86,698.

items.title: Intent to Vacate a Portion of Euclid Avenue and a Portion of Third Street
items.description: A Resolution of the City of Beaumont declaring its intention to vacate a portion of Euclid Avenue between Third Street and 560 feet south of Third Street and a portion of Third Street between Euclid Avenue and 300 feet east of Euclid Avenue.
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of The City of Beaumont Declaring its Intention to Vacate a Portion of Euclid Avenue between Third Street and 560 feet south Third Street and a Portion of Third Street between Euclid Avenue and 300 feet east Euclid Avenue”.

items.title: Presentation and Discussion of City-owned Properties
items.description: City Council requested an item be brought forward to discuss current City-owned properties and their use.
items.recommendation: Discuss and provide staff to direction.
